# Meeovi

> Meeovi is a decentralized social shopping network: people, communities and independent shops in one place, with Bluesky (AT Protocol) sign-in built in. Connect, shop, watch, listen and sell.

## Shop

- [Departments](/departments): browse products by department and category
- [Search](/search): search products, people, spaces and posts
- [Gift cards](/product/gift-cards): buy a Meeovi gift card

## Connect

- [Spaces](/connect/spaces): communities around a shared interest (members only)
- [Feeds](/connect/feeds): posts from the people and spaces you follow (members only)
- [Radio stations](/departments/categories/stations/): live and curated stations

## Account

- [Sign in](/login): email and password, passkey, email sign-in link, or Bluesky
- [Create an account](/register)
- [Workspace](/workspace): orders, lists, settings and seller tools for signed-in members

## About

- [Blog](/blog): news and stories from Meeovi
